subject: planner: allow the optimizer to cache query plans accessing generated columns by default (#51654)
summary: This commit flips `enablePlanCacheForGeneratedCols` to default-on (via fix-control `Fix45798`), making tables with generated columns (including MVIndex/hidden generated columns) eligible for both prepared and non-prepared plan cache, and updates tests accordingly. The change is scoped to cacheability gating; plan cache remains session-scoped and schema-versioned, with range rebuild logic covering IndexMerge paths. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: the default-on behavior remains, with no subsequent revert indicating a discovered correctness regression.
